exposure: blood transfusion practices (components used: PRBC, Platelets, Fresh frozen plasma, Cryoprecipitate)
underlying obstetric risk factors (Anterpartum Haemorrhage, Hypertensive disorders, Post-partum Haemorrhage, ectopic pregnancy)
cohort: 254 obstetric in-patients experiencing emergencies who received blood and blood product transfusions over a one-year period.
finding: Early and adequate use of blood and blood products leads to a significant decline in maternal morbidity and mortality.
